subject.title: feat(backup): add exclude patterns, --smart-exclude, and protected path guards [ai]

question: Should backup excludes be accepted only as an explicit CLI feature that filters every backed-up asset root, or may OpenClaw auto-load `.backupignore` and leave external assets unfiltered with a warning?
rationale: This decides the security and restore boundary for backup contents, and code review cannot safely choose whether implicit local policy files or stateDir-only filtering are acceptable product behavior.

options.title: Require explicit, all-asset excludes
options.body: Require a rebased PR that reads exclude rules only through explicit user action or approved documented policy, applies them per asset root, and removes the unconditional full-archive scan before merge.

options.title: Accept stateDir-only scope
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept stateDir-only filtering if the CLI/docs clearly say external config/workspaces are archived in full and the real proof covers that behavior.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40786 open and close or pause this branch if the backup architecture needs a separate design pass first.

recommendation.title: Require explicit, all-asset excludes
recommendation.body: Require a rebased PR that reads exclude rules only through explicit user action or approved documented policy, applies them per asset root, and removes the unconditional full-archive scan before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: gumadeiras reviewed/merged the original backup CLI and is the clearest history-backed owner for backup behavior direction.
